mechanism_narrative: A sustained negative trend in WORKPLACES mobility over the past four weeks indicates reduced daily commuting and office presence, which will continue to suppress retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES remaining below its pre-period baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in TRANSIT mobility in the most recent week, after a brief recovery, signals a renewed public reluctance to use shared transport, which will reduce spontaneous retail and recreation visits over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by more than 2 points week-on-week after a prior increase.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days increases, even if TRANSIT mobility continues to decline or stagnate.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high RESIDENTIAL mobility coupled with a recent decline in WORKPLACES mobility indicates a sustained preference for staying home or remote work, which will suppress overall retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL mobility remaining high and WORKPLACES mobility remaining low.

mechanism_narrative: A modest week-on-week increase in PARKS mobility, continuing a recovery trend, suggests a cautious return to outdoor leisure, which will provide a slight positive impulse to retail and recreation over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS mobility increases for two consecutive weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC decreases over the next 7 days, even if PARKS mobility continues its upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: The sustained positive baseline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility over the past four weeks indicates a consistent level of essential out-of-home activity, which provides a stable foundation that could slightly pull up discretionary retail and recreation over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days decreases, despite GROCERY_PHARM mobility remaining consistently positive.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES mobility remains below -5% for two consecutive weeks, it will signal a reinforced trend of reduced office attendance, leading to a sustained decrease in retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES mobility remains below -5% for two consecutive weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days, even if WORKPLACES mobility remains consistently low.

mechanism_narrative: The concurrent week-on-week decline in both RETAIL_REC and TRANSIT mobility suggests a recent, possibly informal, tightening of public caution or response to local conditions, which will continue to suppress retail and recreation over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 7 days, despite both RETAIL_REC and TRANSIT mobility having declined in the previous week.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS mobility continues its recent upward trend and crosses into positive territory, it will signify a broader public comfort with outdoor leisure, which will drive an increase in general out-of-home activity, including retail and recreation, over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC decreases over the next 28 days, even if PARKS mobility moves into positive territory.
